format: html

Want to assess the standard curve results from the three qPCR runs.

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(googledrive)
```


```{r, eval = FALSE}
drive_download("cvir_qpcr24_dermo_runs_std_curve",
  path = here::here("data","raw","cvir_qpcr24_dermo_runs_std_curve.xlsx"),
  type = "xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

drive_download("cvir_qpcr24_dermo_runs_std_curve_exp",
  path = here::here("data","raw","cvir_qpcr24_dermo_runs_std_curve_exp.xlsx"),
  type = "xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
data <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data","raw","cvir_qpcr24_dermo_runs_std_curve.xlsx"))

exp <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data","raw","cvir_qpcr24_dermo_runs_std_curve_exp.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  left_join(exp, by = "dilution")
```

```{r}
str(data)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(date = as.factor(date))

levels(data$date)
```

All runs

```{r}
models <- data %>%
  nest(.by = date) %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lm(average_ct ~ log_10_conc, data = .x))
  )

results<-models %>%
  mutate(
    stats = map(model, ~ broom::glance(.x) %>%
                  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared)),
    coefs = map(model, ~ broom::tidy(.x) %>%
                  filter(term == "log_10_conc") %>%
                  select(estimate))
  ) %>%
  unnest(c(stats, coefs)) %>%
  select(
    date,
    r_squared = r.squared,
    adj_r_squared = adj.r.squared,
    slope = estimate
  ) %>%
  mutate(efficiency = (10^(-1 / slope) - 1) * 100)
```



# Take out last dilution


Let's do this but remove dilution 13 (lower detection)

```{r}
data_last <- data %>%
  filter(!dilution == "gb_13_te")
```

```{r}
models <- data_last %>%
  nest(.by = date) %>%
  mutate(
    model = map(data, ~ lm(average_ct ~ log_10_conc, data = .x))
  )

results_last <-models %>%
  mutate(
    stats = map(model, ~ broom::glance(.x) %>%
                  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared)),

```
